method: Fresh Chromium context per invocation, rotating build order; modules and deterministic valid 64 MiB WAV inputs ready before timing. Measures native session creation, complete load() setup, Blob URL creation and optional artwork inspection; excludes metadata readiness, audible playback, file I/O, download, layout/paint and module loading. Complete Blob bytes and browser metadata are checked after timing. Not codec throughput, total-memory measurement, peer comparison or SOTA ranking.
statistics: 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples of native audio setup median ratios, seed 12345. Excludes metadata readiness, playback, layout/paint and file I/O. Baseline operations at or below 10 ms receive no speed claim. Losing and non-improving controls remain. No peer/SOTA ranking.

fixture.description: Deterministic valid mono 8 kHz, 16-bit PCM WAV silence; generated in memory before timing.

diagnostics.description: One initial repetition per representation/build, retained outside final claims. All payloads and browser metadata passed. Typed-array setup was initially slower after the change (25.0 to 42.4 ms), as was Blob setup (6.2 to 10.5 ms). No diagnostic run was dropped.

changes: Cancel prior image/HTML/media element lifecycles; release owned URLs and resources, ignore detached element events and remove listeners on destruction.
Clear stale image dimensions and ignore nonfinite zoom/rotation requests.
Navigate HTML data URLs directly and recognize inline fragments/prologs while retaining the script-disabled iframe sandbox.
Pause and clear replaced/cancelled/destroyed media; report source-element failures instead of leaving loading indefinitely.
Mount the player before optional artwork inspection; preserve volume/mute preferences and discard late artwork or artwork errors after cancellation/replacement/destruction.

Let Blob snapshot ordinary typed views directly, preserving the exact byte slice; avoid a full-input copy for artwork scanning and copy only extracted artwork before the first await. Keep the explicit SharedArrayBuffer view copy.
limits: Engineering old/new setup timing on generated WAV input, not a frontend peer comparison or SOTA ranking.
Timing excludes metadata readiness, audible playback, input I/O, module loading, layout and paint; earlier player mounting is not a measured first-visible-time claim.
Blob still snapshots input bytes; no zero-copy or peak-memory claim. Media codecs remain browser-dependent.
Artwork extraction is unchanged ID3 APIC support; Blob/File inspection is limited to the first 512 KiB. No FLAC/MP4 cover support is added.
ArrayBuffer and Blob baseline medians are below 10 ms and receive no speed claim; non-improving and slower measurements remain recorded.
Image fit/rotation geometry, panorama calibration and backend conversion algorithms are outside this incremental patch.

developmentBrowserCoverage: HTML raw/base64 data URL, fragments/prologs and blocked scripts
Actual image metadata and replacement/abort URL cleanup
Actual valid WAV playback with time advancing, replacement/destroy stop, volume/mute preservation
HTTP404 media source reports an error
HTML upload, existing business families and native text regressions
productionBrowserCoverage: Supported Office sample navigation through the final page
validation.earlierFailures: Initial regression harness lacked URL.createObjectURL and is not production-failure evidence. The corrected harness reproduces all initial 19 regressions. The first browser suite used img.decode() before its load event; the test now waits for the session load event, without a production change for that race. Both local logs are retained.
validation.knownBuildWarnings: Existing duplicate Three.js import warning in Vue tests and the production vendor chunk size warning remain; checks pass.

reproduction: Use isolated source copies preserving earlier changes. Reverse native-lifecycle.patch only in the baseline copy.
Build @filens/core in both copies. Place baseline index.js in tmp/continued-review/native-lifecycle-baseline/dist.
Run node scripts/benchmark-native-media.mjs --iterations 7 --output tmp/continued-review/native-media-reproduced with no tests/builds in progress.
Run core/Vue Vitest directly and Playwright native-lifecycle/text-preview/business-families tests. Production smoke selects HTML upload, code upload and supported Office navigation.
